pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upāsake padaso dhammaṃ vācenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.3: upāsakā bhikkhūsu agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā viharanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū upāsake padaso dhammaṃ vācessanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --la--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave upāsake padaso dhammaṃ vācetha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā upāsake padaso dhammaṃ vācessatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.14: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:1.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannaṃ padaso dhammaṃ vāceyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.1.6: bhikkhuñ ca bhikkhuniñ ca ṭhapetvā avaseso anupasampanno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.1.14: rūpaṃ aniccan ti vuccamāno run ti opāteti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.1.16: rūpaṃ aniccan ti vuccamāno vedanā aniccā 'ti saddaṃ nicchāreti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.1.17: yañ ca padaṃ yañ ca anupadaṃ yañ ca anvakkharaṃ yañ ca anubyañjanaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.1.20: buddhabhāsito sāvakabhāsito isibhāsito devatābhāsito atthupasañhito dhammupasañhito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.1.22: padena vāceti, pade pade āpatti pācittiyassa;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.2.1: anupasampanne anupasampannasaññī padaso dhammaṃ vāceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.2.2: anupasampanne vematiko padaso dhammaṃ vāceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc4:2.2.3: anupasampanne upasampannasaññī padaso dhammaṃ vāceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
